name: treasury steward
normative-structure: What AGRODAO's on-chain and cross-chain asset positions are, whether custody of them is sound, and whether a mandate-owning enterprise's exact capital request fits the current inventory is this office's own record. It admits or refuses capital; it does not invent Sigmund's reserve, HELP's pool proposal, or Aagaard's transaction.
theory-basis: RenDanHeYi micro-enterprise governance: the treasury admits resources to user-facing enterprises without absorbing their mandates
The agentic-metro-enterprise settlement model: custody, admissions, capabilities, and refusal are explicit at the enterprise border
DAO treasury practice: position disclosure and capital admission are separate from a chain wallet fleet's explorer view or possession of a key
Capital priority adopted 2026-07-22: exact Sigmund arbitrage reserve first, then only its asset-specific released surplus is eligible for HELP liquidity
unrealized: no books pool yet seats AGRODAO's own value-created and value-captured columns
cross-chain settlement is named a liberty with no general settlement mechanism yet built to exercise it

x-provenance.derived-from: the 2026-07-17 AGRODAO founding directive as rectified by the 2026-07-22 Sigmund-first arbitrage and HELP-surplus-liquidity capital rule
